entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: httpsys-encoded-url #62001
  • Duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute errors in .NET 9.0 Blazor projects with VS Code #61998
  • Consider restricting what proxies you accept forwarded certificates from #61996
  • MSAL login stucks during "Completing Login" in blazor wasm in .NET 9 #61991
  • [Known Build Error] Failed webcil conversion: image is too small #61987

Closed

  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #61988
  • Parameter validation in minimal API not working as expected #61995
  • Unable to find package Microsoft.DotNet.HotReload.Agent #61999
  • [OpenApi] SourceGen error using xml docs for Static methods taking generic parameters. #61864
  • [Identity] SetLockoutEndDateAsync can't set a time before existed value #61901
  • Perf improvement: fortunes_ef #61974
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-noop #61984

PullRequests

Created

  • [8.0] Delete src/arcade directory #61994
    8.0.x
  • [Blazor] Update `AuthenticationStateProvider` to take advantage of Declarative persistent component state #61992
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • perf: Antiforgery token validation & generation #61989
    area-networking

Merged

  • Add WebAssemblyHotReloadCapabilities to Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.props #61946
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • [main] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `90a4152` to `5719306` #61963
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #61929
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0-preview5
  • Update `ResourceCollectionProvider` to take advantage of Declarative persistent component state #61748
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • Blazor - rendering metrics and tracing #61609
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5

Updated

  • [IIS] Manually parse exe bitness #61894
    feature-iis, area-networking
  • Follow-up: Improve stopping renderer, fix identity template #61633
    area-blazor, feature-prerendering, feature-blazor-navigation, .NET 10 Planning
